assets.name: idle
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game animation sprite sheet. Create a square 1024x1024 PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, not white, not checkerboard painted into the art. Exactly FOUR animation frames in a perfectly aligned 2 by 2 grid, each cell 512x512. No lines, labels, typography, numbers or cell borders. Each frame contains exactly one full-body cute mint-green alien from the reference with two yellow bulb-tipped antennae, huge navy eyes with yellow star pupils, pink cheeks, yellow chest star, small round feet, translucent turquoise/yellow orbit ring around its waist. Preserve its identity, soft glossy toy-like 3D illustration and colors. Orthographic frontal view. Fixed camera, consistent scale, center at x256 of each cell, feet baseline near y452, complete body including antennae within x60..452/y45..452. Generous 40px clear transparent gutters so slicing produces clean independent sprites. No ground shadow, no external floating symbols, no environment. Do not add weapons, clothing, ears or recognizable franchise elements. Frames ordered top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. A calm, gentle looping dance: 1 smiling upright arms relaxed, 2 gently lean left with left hand raised, 3 centered with subtle blink and knees slightly bent, 4 gently lean right with right hand raised. Low amplitude pleasant dance; all four full body sprites same apparent size.
